/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import os, tempfile, shutil, struct

music = Path('/home/user/Music')
files = sorted(music.glob('*.mp3'))

def syncsafe(n):
    return bytes([(n >> 21) & 0x7f, (n >> 14) & 0x7f, (n >> 7) & 0x7f, n & 0x7f])

def unsyncsafe(b):
    return ((b[0] & 0x7f) << 21) | ((b[1] & 0x7f) << 14) | ((b[2] & 0x7f) << 7) | (b[3] & 0x7f)

def text_frame(frame_id, text):
    payload = b'\\x01' + text.encode('utf-16')
    return frame_id.encode('ascii') + struct.pack('>I', len(payload)) + b'\\x00\\x00' + payload

def make_tag(artist, title):
    frames = text_frame('TIT2', title) + text_frame('TPE1', artist)
    # Padding gives tag editors room for small future changes without rewriting audio.
    body = frames + (b'\\x00' * 1024)
    return b'ID3' + bytes([3, 0, 0]) + syncsafe(len(body)) + body

for path in files:
    stem = path.stem
    if ' - ' not in stem:
        print(f'SKIP: {path.name} (no \" - \" separator)')
        continue
    artist, title = stem.split(' - ', 1)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    start = 0
    if len(data) >= 10 and data[:3] == b'ID3':
        start = 10 + unsyncsafe(data[6:10])
        if data[5] & 0x10:  # footer present
            start += 10
    audio = data[start:]
    if len(audio) >= 128 and audio[-128:-125] == b'TAG':
        audio = audio[:-128]
    new_data = make_tag(artist, title) + audio

    fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=path.name + '.', suffix='.tmp', dir=path.parent)
    tmp = Path(tmp_name)
    try:
        with os.fdopen(fd, 'wb') as f:
            f.write(new_data)
        shutil.copymode(path, tmp)
        os.replace(tmp, path)
        print(f'OK: {path.name} -> artist=\"{artist}\", title=\"{title}\"')
    finally:
        if tmp.exists():
            tmp.unlink()
PY"
